questions.answer: Efficiency is useful energy output divided by total energy input, or useful power output divided by total power input. Its percentage range is 0% to 100% inclusive.
accepted_alternatives: The same relationship written symbolically using eta.
A range from zero to one if clearly stated as a decimal range.
questions.unit_policy: No unit is attached to efficiency.

marking_points.text: States efficiency as useful energy output divided by total energy input, or useful power output divided by total power input.
